UK Services

The same standard. Delivered in the UK.

Our UK operation delivers to exactly the same standard as our North American work. The deliverable architecture is identical: navigable digital twin, narrated video walkthrough, conditions report, equipment schedule where relevant, labeled photo storyboard, and ScopeWalk platform access. Where survey-grade accuracy is required — and for heritage and listed building work, it usually is — we capture using professional LiDAR instrumentation producing millimetre-accurate point cloud data.

The difference is context. In the UK, we bring particular strength to heritage and listed building documentation, estate work, and projects where the fabric is sensitive and the documentation needs to serve conservation as well as commercial requirements.

Heritage & Listed Buildings

Documentation that understands the building.

Our principal's background includes hands-on construction and conservation work on some of Britain's most significant historic properties. That experience shapes how we approach heritage documentation in the UK — understanding materials, understanding what matters to conservation architects, and producing records that heritage bodies can actually use.

We work with Grade I and Grade II listed buildings, scheduled monuments, conservation areas, and significant private estates. The documentation is designed to serve English Heritage, Historic Scotland, Cadw, and equivalent bodies alongside your architect and project team.
